title: Prove the exact power-tariff transition for direct-flow leaves (no new κ)
body:
## Summary

Scoped proof produced by Nick Petalas: the fixed raw-p7 direct-flow leaf tariff has an exact three-regime asymptotic. With `lambda=t-alpha>0`, `v=lambda+u`, and `A(u)=121^(-u)Z(t+u)/Z(t)`:

```text
v > 0: M_G(u,delta) -> A(u) lambda/v
v = 0: M_G(u,delta) ~ A(u) lambda sigma sqrt(pi G/2)
v < 0: M_G(u,delta) ~ A(u) lambda sigma sqrt(2 pi G) exp(-v delta) R(u)^G
       R(u)=Z(t+u)/Z(alpha) exp(-v log5) > 1
```

The threshold is exactly `t+u=alpha`, for every fixed real shift u, uniformly across bounded lockstep offsets. The closed upper endpoint is explicitly a fixed-depth extension; actual integer ranks use the original floor depth and a half-open offset interval. A bounded mean log-depth therefore does not justify every power tariff.

This extends DLamdata's #6118 tilted local-limit framework and Ryanson Jonathan / pinterbanget's #4467 leaf model. The mathematical citation is pinned to #6118 at `6310550e932de70243fc2aaab6f4885688b6fe21`; its newer head reorganizes documentation without changing PROOF.md. No predecessor certificate is replayed or claimed as this contribution. Credit also zxv's #4436 direct flow, Cinna Davis / 1337isnot1337's #4405 refined induction, Jacob Alan Sussman's compiler and Stone's classical local limit theorem.

Claim type: **scoped proof**, corroborated by exact finite identities. No new κ or selected-frontier change. Base: `721c03822c421b7f7fcbb2598993b947c4d88419`.

## Evidence

Before this contribution, #6118 supplied exponential deficit and mean convergence, without the full power tariff or its critical/divergent regimes. PROOF.md derives an exact tilted quotient and the three asymptotics; verify.py checks the new finite algebra with two separately implemented prefix/leaf enumerations.

Local normal and optimized checks pass: 15 fixtures, 225 moment identities, 450 tilted quotients, 210 second-measure-change identities, 10,191 accepted ordered prefixes counted across fixtures, and eight rejecting controls. The checks compute exact rational values at integer exponents; they do not numerically certify the infinite-parameter theorem. Both registered commands ran locally in under one second each.

From the repository root, using the tested CPython 3.12 interpreter:

```sh
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -W error -B research/direct-flow-leaf-tariff/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -O -W error -B research/direct-flow-leaf-tariff/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/direct-flow-leaf-tariff
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/direct-flow-leaf-tariff --check-source-history --check-modes
```

Other hosts may substitute their CPython 3.12 executable. Registered replay, metadata/source bindings, committed-byte/source-history/mode checks and the official eight-file export/input-coverage check pass. Direct normal/optimized replay also passes from a read-only export without Git.

## Limitations and unrun obligations

Stone's nonlattice interval local-limit theorem, as specialized in #6118, is a cited mathematical dependency. Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed. The intended raw-p7 crossing exponent is inherited; this package proves its theorem for every fixed t>alpha and does not recalculate that crossing.

No finite-depth error rate, practical rank threshold, source/boundary/leaf share theorem, complete refined-induction ceiling, native implementation or supplier admission is established. The historical raw-p7 measure is not the selected #6030 invoice. All five selected framework assumptions remain. Full selected replay, Lean and Docker were not run.

## Open next questions

- Derive the compatible non-leaf asymptotics and relative masses needed for the complete normalized exit tariff; begin with source and boundary measures at the same tilted barrier.
- Give explicit finite-depth errors for the three regimes; begin with quantitative interval local limits for the fixed log{2,3,5} support, retaining its recurrent phases.

## Related open work

- #6118 proves qualitative leaf-deficit saturation for this same law. This contribution builds on its framework and evaluates the full power tariff, including critical and divergent regimes; its saturation certificate is not audited here.
- #4547 repairs replay metadata in predecessor packages, including the historical direct-flow chain. This isolated package adds a mathematical cost calculation and adopts no pending repair.

- #6128 proves an explicit finite-depth tail envelope and clipping-error bound for the same historical raw-p7 law. This PR derives asymptotic power tariffs and their critical/divergent regimes; it supplies no finite-depth rate. No extra computations were run to compare the results.

## CI notes

**Uncertified by CI** at commit `f58e29052a0bbb4e123ea777b5e03321fde6f31f`. In [run 40692604534](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/40692604534), `plan` failed during Onboarding helper tests and the package replay was skipped. **The package replay did not run in CI.**

The failure is inherited from current main `721c03822c421b7f7fcbb2598993b947c4d88419`, the PR6030 κ-admission commit pushed with `[skip ci]`. Its selected record and onboarding docs do not satisfy two existing synchronization tests:

- `test_research_current_status.CurrentStatusTests.test_current_section_matches_selected_record` expects the exact marker `**0.003125804**` in `docs/research/current-status.md`. That document instead bolds the longer expression `**0.003125804 = 781451/250000000**`, so the literal marker is absent.
- `test_research_current_status.CurrentCiNavigationTests.test_current_ci_section_matches_selected_record` expects `make frontier6030-verify` in `docs/ci.md`, which still describes #5599 and `make frontier5599-verify`.

The failed-job log reports 678 onboarding tests, two failures and 23 skips. [PR #6120's run 40691776027](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/40691776027) fails the same two tests, confirmed from its failed-job log. Neither failing document is changed by this PR. These are baseline failures, not failures caused by the leaf-tariff package.

All listed local checks passed, but this hosted run certified no package replay. **This PR needs a maintainer re-run after main is fixed.** No push, main-document fix or CI re-run was performed for this blocker.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way. **Blast Radius:** isolated research package. Existing sources, selected records and frozen evidence are unchanged.
